about.title: About
about.heading: About Kerala Web Watch
about.intro: Kerala Web Watch is an independent, open-source civic project. It is not an official Government of Kerala service and is not affiliated with any department it audits. It exists so a citizen can check, in plain language, whether a government website works right now, and so a webmaster can see exactly what to fix.
about.contactBody: Source and issue tracker: github.com/hashin/kerala-web-watch. A public contact email is not yet set — until then, please use a GitHub issue.
about.contributeBody: Found a site we're missing, or a wrong entry? Open an issue or a pull request against the registry.
about.privacyBody: No cookies, no analytics, no third-party requests of any kind on this site. Fonts are self-hosted.
about.licenceBody: Code is MIT-licensed; the registry and audit data are CC-BY-4.0.

college.government.meaning: Run directly by the Government of Kerala.
college.aided.label: Government-aided college
college.aided.meaning: Run by a private trust, society or community organisation; the Government of Kerala pays its teachers' salaries and fills most of its seats.
college.unconfirmed.label: College — not yet confirmed whether government or government-aided
college.unconfirmed.meaning: We have not found an official document that says which one it is, so we have not guessed.
actions.title: Action report
actions.headline: {n} of {total} Kerala government websites need urgent action
actions.intro: Every website's most urgent problem, graded 1 (act now) to 5 (minor), so a webmaster or department knows what to fix first. Each row says what is wrong, in plain words.
actions.grade.1.label: Grade 1 — Act now: visitors may be at risk
actions.grade.2.label: Grade 2 — Act now: citizens cannot use the site
actions.grade.3.label: Grade 3 — Fix soon
actions.grade.4.label: Grade 4 — Plan a fix
actions.grade.5.label: Grade 5 — Minor
actions.grade.1.meaning: Signs the site may have been tampered with, or that it now points somewhere it should not.
actions.grade.2.meaning: The site is down, broken or shows a browser warning, so people cannot use it.
actions.grade.3.meaning: A serious problem that puts visitors or the site's reliability at risk.
actions.grade.4.meaning: A real weakness worth scheduling a fix for.
actions.bucket.unverifiable: Could not be checked from outside India
